newsitem.title: ESTONIA: KURESSAARE TO ISSUE NEW CPS, MORE TO FOLLOW.
newsitem.headline: KURESSAARE TO ISSUE NEW CPS, MORE TO FOLLOW.

text.p: The council of the island town of Kuressaare will issue commercial papers worth five million kroons this week and 18 million kroons in June, investment house Talinvest said on Tuesday.
The two-month commercial papers, to be issued this week, have a yield of 7.5 percent, Talinvest project leader Rain Nuka told Reuters.
"The issue of five million kroons is complementary to the issue of a month ago," he added. Then, Kuressaare issued eight million kroons with a yield of 8.71 percent.
Kuressaare will issue three-month CPs worth 18 million kroons on June 26. It will redeem previous issues and bring five million kroons more to the market, Nuka said.
The council of the south central town of Viljandi will issue new CPs on June 6. The sum will probably be 25 million kroons, Nuka said.
Sweet producer Kalev is to issue new CPs in July, when it redeems an issue of April 16. The issue of 15 million kroons had a yield of 8.75 percent, Nuka said.
